blocked.danger_lead: NanaGuard stopped you from opening a site that is known for malware or phishing (fake login and payment pages).
blocked.danger_title: This site may harm your computer

check.ask: To search in {lang}, Chrome needs to download a free {lang} language pack once. It stays on this computer.
guard.fake_site_body: The real {brand} website is {official}. Fake websites like this one steal passwords and card details. Please don't type anything here.
guard.fake_site_short: You are on {host}. The real {brand} website is {official}.
guard.fake_site_title: This is not the real {brand} website
guard.pw_reuse_body: It is not {name}. If a message or call sent you here, it may be a fake page trying to steal your password. To be safe, change your {name} password at {site}.
guard.pw_reuse_title: You just typed your {name} password on a different website
guard.scam_crypto_body: Asking for Bitcoin or crypto payments, 'doubling' your coins, or paying a fee to unlock money are classic scams. Crypto payments can't be reversed.
guard.scam_crypto_title: Be careful: this page asks you to send cryptocurrency
guard.scam_giftcard_body: This page asks for payment with gift cards. That is always a scam: once you share the card numbers, the money is gone for good.
guard.scam_giftcard_title: No real company or government asks to be paid in gift cards
guard.scam_refund_body: Scammers pretend they 'refunded too much' and ask you to send the difference back, often by gift card, wire or crypto. Real companies fix refunds themselves.
guard.scam_refund_title: This looks like a refund scam
guard.scam_remote_body: This page asks you to install a remote-access app (like AnyDesk or TeamViewer). Scammers use these apps to take over computers and bank accounts. Real companies don't ask for this out of the blue.
guard.scam_remote_title: Never let a stranger connect to your computer
guard.scam_support_body: Microsoft, Apple and your bank never show warnings with a phone number to call. Don't call the number and don't let anyone connect to your computer.
guard.scam_support_title: This looks like a fake tech-support page
guard.sure_safe: I'm sure this website is safe
isolated.clickfix_line1: This page secretly tried to copy a dangerous command. It wants you to press Windows + R (or open Terminal) and paste it. That would install a virus.
isolated.clickfix_line2: Real websites never ask you to do this. NanaGuard replaced the command with a harmless message.
lens.fallback: Google Lens didn't open. Save the picture and upload it at lens.google.com.
lens.status: Opening Google Lens to find where this picture comes from...
options.allowed_desc: NanaGuard stays off on these sites. Add a site only if it stops working properly, for example a bank's payment window.
options.backup_desc: Save your blocked, allowed and hidden lists, or load them on another computer.
options.bad_domain: That doesn't look like a website address.
options.blocked_desc: These websites, and every page or ad loaded from them, are blocked completely.
options.fact_answer_desc: ChatGPT replies in this language and Google opens in it.
options.fact_lang_desc: Choose the language of the answers, and the language to look for sources in.
options.fact_search_desc: Pick a language to translate the text into before searching Google, News and fact-checkers. For example, find English fact-checks of a Bulgarian story.
options.fact_search_same: The language of the text (no translation)
options.fact_translate_note: In Chrome the text is translated on your computer by Chrome's built-in translator. The first time, Chrome asks to download a free language pack. In Firefox the text is searched as it is.
options.feature_fake_screens: Full-page fake "your computer is infected" screens
options.feature_fullscreen: Fullscreen and keyboard-lock hijacks used by fake support scams
options.feature_loops: Endless alert/confirm/print loops and back-button traps
options.feature_networks: Known popunder ad networks, blocked at network level
options.feature_popups: Popups and popunders that open without a real click
options.filters_desc: Community-maintained lists, compiled into fast browser rules and refreshed every week with each NanaGuard release.
options.forget_confirm: Forget everything smart detection has learned?
options.hidden_desc: Things you hid with **Hide an ad on this page**. Remove one to bring it back.
options.hidden_empty: Nothing hidden yet. Open a page, click the NanaGuard icon, then **Hide an ad on this page**.
options.lang_desc: The language of NanaGuard's buttons, settings and warnings.
options.networks_desc: Companies NanaGuard has seen serving ads. Blocked ones are stopped on every site.
options.networks_empty: Nothing learned yet. Browse normally and this list fills up on its own.
options.perm_needed: **One more step:** allow NanaGuard to run on websites, otherwise it can't block anything.
options.protection_desc: Turn NanaGuard on or off everywhere.
options.scam_desc: Plain-language warnings at the moment something looks dangerous. Every warning has a "this site is safe" option.
options.smart_desc: Spots ads no list knows about, the way a person would: "Ad" and "Sponsored" labels, AdChoices icons, standard banner sizes, and boxes served by other companies. It learns as you browse.
options.smart_feature_local: Everything is learned and stored only on this computer.
options.smart_feature_remember: Ads it finds on a site are remembered and hidden instantly on your next visit.
options.smart_feature_three: When the same ad company shows up on **3 different sites**, it is blocked everywhere.
options.stats_desc: Counts are stored only on this computer.
options.trusted_desc: Sites you marked "safe" in a warning. NanaGuard still blocks ads there but won't show scam or fake-site warnings.
options.update_how: **How to update** (you installed NanaGuard yourself, so it can't update on its own):
options.update_reload: Open {page} and click the reload button on NanaGuard.
options.update_unzip: Unzip it **into the same folder** as before, replacing the old files. Your settings are kept.

tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.ads.desc: EasyList, uBlock filters and Peter Lowe's list.
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.ads.title: Ads & banners
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.annoyances.desc: Fanboy cookie & annoyance lists and uBlock annoyances. Also auto-closes 'Subscribe / special offer / No thanks' popups.
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.annoyances.title: Cookie banners & annoyances
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.privacy.desc: EasyPrivacy and uBlock privacy. Also strips tracking tags (utm_…) from links.
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.privacy.title: Trackers
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.security.desc: URLhaus and phishing lists. Dangerous sites show a warning page.
tbl.CATEGORY_INFO.security.title: Malware & phishing
tbl.GUARD_INFO.ai.desc: Flags AI-made and deepfake videos and images using platform labels, AI tool names, viewer comments, AI watermarks in the picture (read on your computer) and image Content Credentials. Warns about deepfake scam videos.
tbl.GUARD_INFO.ai.title: Real or AI? checks
tbl.GUARD_INFO.clickfix.desc: Blocks pages that secretly copy a virus command and tell you to press Windows + R and paste it.
tbl.GUARD_INFO.clickfix.title: Fake 'verify you're human' guard
tbl.GUARD_INFO.factcheck.desc: Right-click any text → Check facts, plus a button under YouTube videos. Opens Google, fact-checkers or ChatGPT in a new tab.
tbl.GUARD_INFO.factcheck.title: 'Check facts' buttons
tbl.GUARD_INFO.password.desc: Warns if you type the password of an important site (bank, email, PayPal…) on a different website. Only a scrambled fingerprint is stored, never the password.
tbl.GUARD_INFO.password.title: Password alert
tbl.GUARD_INFO.phishing.desc: Warns on look-alike sites (paypa1.com, paypal-login.top, letters swapped for foreign look-alikes) and pages pretending to be your bank, email or a shop.
tbl.GUARD_INFO.phishing.title: Fake website warnings
tbl.GUARD_INFO.scam.desc: Warns when a page asks you to install remote-access apps, pay with gift cards or Bitcoin, or call a 'support' number.
tbl.GUARD_INFO.scam.title: Scam request warnings
